topic: F2FS large-folio read support and lock tracing
status: unresolved necessity; candidate decisions remain provisional
evidence: SDK common config enables F2FS and IOSTAT; goldfish x86 fstab uses ext4. LTS lacks ACK f2fs_read_data_large_folio and read_folio_count telemetry, so these fixes target code not currently ported. A missing SDK caller is not proof the optional generic feature can be omitted. Review the full feature series and Android configuration/consumer contracts before finalizing.

evidence: ACK namei.c error-unwind fix concerns IS_DEVICE_ALIASING paths absent from native LTS. The current source keeps the native LTS filesystem and SDK ext4/virtio storage path, but absence of the alias feature is a pending feature-selection decision; do not use its absence to claim this fix unnecessary without completing that review.

In __free_page_pinner, page_ext_next is skipped by continue when an entry is unflagged, and capture_page_state uses the original page pointer. This follows ACK but may miss later pages in a higher-order allocation. The reference-lifetime fix is retained; verify iteration semantics separately before claiming optional debug tracking correctness.
